title: Chaining is weaker than raw flick speed
summary: The player may have fast single flicks, but the full kill sequence breaks because of misses, extra micro-adjustments, or poor exits.
telltales: Fast flicks do not produce equally fast kill strings
The run loses time between kills rather than only during the flick
contraindications: Do not judge flick quality only by one isolated fast movement
avoid: Trading away first-shot accuracy for a bit more raw speed
